description: This PHP source file defines a utility class 'DauxHelper' for handling configurations, file path manipulations, theme management, and internal link resolution within a documentation generator framework.

classes.name: DauxHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for path manipulation, theme configuration, internal file resolution, and URL validation within the documentation system.

methods.name: rebaseConfiguration
methods.description: Adjusts the base URL and theme settings of the configuration object.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves and caches theme configuration based on current URL and theme variant.

methods.name: getCleanPath
methods.description: Removes './', '../' sequences from a path string without verifying the actual filesystem path.

methods.name: getFilenames
methods.description: Generates possible filename variants for a given source file part, considering valid content extensions.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Locates a file within a directory tree structure based on a request path, supporting navigation and filename variations.

methods.name: slugBase
methods.description: Converts a string to an ASCII-only base suitable for URL or slug generation.

methods.name: urlSlug
methods.description: Generates a URL-friendly slug from a string, replacing spaces and invalid characters.

methods.name: linkSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL-safe, lowercase, hyphen-separated string from a source string.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Computes a relative filesystem path from one directory or file to another.

methods.name: isAbsolutePath
methods.description: Determines if a given path is absolute.

methods.name: getAbsolutePath
methods.description: Returns an absolute filesystem path, converting relative paths using the current working directory.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a path exists as a directory or file.

methods.name: resolveInternalFile
methods.description: Resolves an internal file link to a file or directory object within the documentation tree.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is non-empty and not a fragment.

methods.name: isExternalUrl
methods.description: Detects if a URL is external (HTTP, mailto, etc).

methods.name: isDataUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a data URI for images.
